ruleset.name: Apex Best Practices Rules
ruleset.description: Custom rules for Apex best practices (modifiers, test classes, code quality)

rule.name: FinalVariablesMustBeFinal
rule.message: Variables that are never reassigned must be declared as final to enforce immutability and improve code clarity
rule.description:
Detects variables that are never reassigned after their initial declaration and flags them as violations if they are not declared as final. This rule enforces immutability where appropriate, improves code clarity by indicating that the variable's value won't change, and helps prevent accidental reassignment bugs.
The rule checks local variables within methods and excludes: - Loop variables (for and for-each loops) - Method parameters - Variables that are reassigned, incremented, decremented, or modified with compound assignment operators
Version: 1.0.1
